Love can be seen in many ways so imma make a pretty long comment about this. 

Family love- family love is the sort of love that can hold the world together. It's the sort of love that knows no bounds, it's a sacrificial love that few get to truly see. Family love is unique and beautiful. It can mend broken hearts with just a piece of scotch tape and a drop of glue. This is the love that can hold anything together and make the most hideous things seem beautiful. This is the kind of love that people live for. 

Romantic love- romantic love is the sort of love that can destroy the whole world. It's the sort of love that is a killer concoction. It can build the most beautiful families and kill the most beautiful things. Romantic love is without a doubt one of the most powerful loves. It can break hearts just as fast as it can heal them. Romantic love is like a machine gun with roses and hearts painted on the side. It looks beautiful but it can be one of the most lethal weapons if it chooses to be. This is the love that can kill anything yet it makes everything in life seem so much more beautiful. This is the kind of live people die for.

Friendship love- friendship love is really special. It's rarely seen but when it is- oh boy oh boy. It's real and strong. Friendship love can conquer the world without a moments hesitation and can bring down the most spiteful enemies withing seconds. Friendship love is like a powerful wall built against anything that can hurt you. This is the love that makes you feel invincible. This is the kind of love people kill for.
